stories.title: Bitcoin Tests $78.3K Support as Crude Oil Hits Three-Month High
stories.summary: Bitcoin is testing support near $78,300 as US crude oil prices reach a three-month high, according to Cointelegraph. CryptoSlate reports a split in positioning: options traders are loading up on bullish calls even as spot traders keep selling. A weaker dollar this week may materialize, but CryptoSlate notes that alone may not deliver the liquidity conditions bulls say they need for a sustained rally.
stories.whyItMatters: The gap between options bullishness and spot selling, plus the macro backdrop of oil and dollar moves, matters more for near-term direction than any single price level.
whatToWatch: Whether the $78.3K support level holds
Dollar index movement through the week
Whether spot selling continues despite options demand
questions: What is driving spot sellers to keep unloading while options traders buy calls?
Would a weaker dollar actually translate into the liquidity conditions bulls need?

sources.title: Bitcoin bulls are loading up on calls while spot traders keep selling
Bitcoin could get the dollar drop bulls want this week without getting the liquidity rally they need
Bitcoin faces key support test at $78.3K as US crude oil hits three-month high

stories.title: Franklin Templeton Digital-Asset Veteran Named CEO of StablecoinX
stories.summary: A digital-asset industry veteran from Franklin Templeton has taken the helm at StablecoinX, Cointelegraph reported. The report did not detail the executive's specific mandate or strategic plans.
stories.whyItMatters: Leadership hires from major asset managers into stablecoin-focused firms point to continued institutional interest in stablecoin infrastructure.
whatToWatch: Any strategic announcements from StablecoinX under the new CEO
questions: What changes, if any, does the new leadership plan to make?

stories.title: Gemini Wins Payment License in Singapore
stories.summary: Exchange Gemini has received a payment services license in Singapore that will let it offer crypto services in the city-state, Cointelegraph reported.
stories.whyItMatters: Singapore is a major regulated hub for crypto in Asia, so the license extends Gemini's regulated footprint at a time when exchanges are racing to secure formal licensing globally.
whatToWatch: Which specific services Gemini launches in Singapore
Whether Gemini pursues further regional licenses
questions: What is the scope of the license and which products does it cover?

stories.title: Cybercrime Ringleader Pleads Guilty in $245M Crypto Theft Case
stories.summary: Malone Lam, described as the ringleader of a cybercrime operation, has pleaded guilty to conspiracy charges tied to the theft of $245 million in crypto, according to Cointelegraph.
stories.whyItMatters: The case is one of the largest crypto theft prosecutions and shows law enforcement following through on major digital-asset crime, a reminder of persistent security risk to holders.
whatToWatch: Sentencing outcome
Whether co-conspirators face separate charges
Any restitution to victims
questions: How was the $245 million actually stolen?
Will victims recover any of the funds?

stories.title: New York Town Weighs Ban on Crypto Mining and AI Data Centers
stories.summary: A town in New York is considering a ban that would cover both crypto mining operations and AI data centers, Cointelegraph reported.
stories.whyItMatters: Local pushback over energy use continues to shape where US miners can operate, and pairing the mining ban with AI data centers signals a broader local energy-policy fight.
whatToWatch: The outcome of the town's vote or decision
Whether other municipalities follow with similar proposals
questions: What specifically is driving the proposed ban — energy costs, noise, or other concerns?
Which operators would be affected if it passes?

stories.title: Crypto Lobbies Launch TV Ad Campaign Against Banks to Push CLARITY Act
stories.summary: Crypto industry lobbying groups have launched a last-minute television advertising campaign targeting banks, aimed at building support to pass the CLARITY Act, according to CryptoSlate.
stories.whyItMatters: The CLARITY Act would set market-structure rules for digital assets, and an ad blitz this late suggests the bill is nearing a decision point with real friction between banks and the crypto industry.
whatToWatch: Legislative timeline and any vote on the CLARITY Act
Response from the banking industry
questions: Which lawmakers or provisions are the ads specifically targeting?
How likely is passage given the current opposition?

stories.title: Strategy's $250 Bitcoin-Branded Jordans Sell Out
stories.summary: A $250 Bitcoin-themed Air Jordan sneaker tied to Strategy, the Michael Saylor-led company that holds roughly 4% of bitcoin's supply, has sold out, CryptoSlate reported.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows Strategy extending its bitcoin identity into consumer branding, though this is a marketing sideshow rather than a fundamental shift in its treasury strategy.
whatToWatch: Whether Strategy expands its merchandising efforts further
questions: How large was the actual sales volume?
Is this a one-off promotion or the start of a broader consumer push?

stories.title: Bitmine Adds $70M in Ether, Holdings Reach 5.93M ETH

stories.whyItMatters: Bitmine is among the largest corporate holders of ether, so continued accumulation points to sustained institutional treasury demand for ETH alongside bitcoin.

Any market reaction in ETH price
Further disclosures on Bitmine's treasury strategy
questions: What is funding these purchases?
Will the accumulation pace continue or slow?

stories.title: Metaplanet's Bitcoin Gains Balloon Executive Pay Plan to 319 Million Shares
stories.summary: A rise in Metaplanet's bitcoin holdings has expanded an executive compensation plan originally set at 46 million shares to roughly 319 million shares, CryptoSlate reported.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows how bitcoin treasury strategies can dramatically inflate executive pay and dilute shareholders, a governance concern for investors in bitcoin-holding companies.
whatToWatch: Shareholder reaction to the expanded pay plan
Whether the board revisits the plan's terms
Further disclosures on the plan's mechanics
questions: What specific formula or trigger increased the share count so sharply?
How is the board responding to shareholder concerns, if any?

stories.title: Strive Buys $109M in Bitcoin, Preferred Stock Push Nears $1B
stories.summary: Strive purchased $109 million of bitcoin and is advancing a preferred stock offering that is approaching $1 billion, Decrypt reported.
stories.whyItMatters: It's another entrant in the corporate bitcoin-treasury trend, and the scale of capital raised via preferred stock is worth tracking alongside the purchases themselves.
whatToWatch: Completion of the roughly $1 billion preferred stock raise
Any further bitcoin purchases by Strive
questions: What are the terms of the preferred stock offering?
How strong is investor demand for it?
